content: FTS5 suggestions: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE vocab USING fts5vocab(fts_table,'row') exposes term+cnt; prefix completion via SELECT term,cnt FROM vocab WHERE term LIKE 'prefix%' ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT n (endorsed on sqlite.org forum). Terms are tokenizer output (porter stems for SIF). spellfix1 is a separate loadable extension (edit-distance did-you-mean) not in standard builds; pure-Python Levenshtein/difflib over fts5vocab candidates avoids shipping a compiled extension. unicode61/porter do not segment CJK, so vocab suggestions skew ASCII; CJK coverage needs history-based suggestions.
